turns.user_message: Hola! What restaurants do you have?
turns.agent_response:
Welcome to Mohegan Sun. Since you are looking for a recommendation on a Friday night, SolToro Taqueria & Tequila Bar in the Casino of the Earth is a fantastic choice for a lively atmosphere and authentic Mexican flavors. 

The scent of charred peppers and fresh citrus hits you as soon as you arrive, and their house-made tacos are some of the most vibrant dishes on the property. They are open until 11:00 PM tonight, feature a casual dress code, and the price range is moderate. An insider tip for you: their collection of over 200 tequilas and mezcals is one of the most extensive in the region. 

After a few tacos, the Wolf Den is just a short walk away in the Casino of the Earth and usually has some high-energy live music going on. Are you looking for a full sit-down dinner or just some light bites and drinks to start your night?
